name: TOP ROW SEATS
clue: Typists still use this layout, named for letters on the top row of Christopher Sholes's 1870s typewriters

name: PLUMB CRAZY
clue: The Latin name of this heavy metal gave us the word 'plumber', since Romans made water pipes from it

name: SPLIT PERSONALITY
clue: Greek thinkers named this for being uncuttable, a label that 20th-century physics proved wrong

name: BROKEN AND MENDED
clue: This branch of math takes its name from 'al-jabr', Arabic for 'restoration', in a 9th-century book title
